# CAD fixtures (DWG/DXF import, issue #230)

Generated by `scripts/make_cad_fixtures.py`. The drawings are fictional, and the plan drawing
reuses the Kestrel Road model from `scripts/roadset`. Do not edit these files by hand.

| Fixture | Covers |
|---|---|
| `basic-entities` | Model space only (mm): one of each common 2D entity, linetypes, lineweights, ACI and true colour, TEXT/MTEXT, solid and pattern hatch with a hole, a non-plotting layer |
| `blocks` | Nested, scaled, rotated and mirrored INSERTs, MINSERT grid, attributes, BYBLOCK colour |
| `kestrel-plan` | Metres; two layouts (A1 and A3), viewports at 1:500, 1:2000 (twisted 30°, two layers frozen) and 1:100; aligned dimensions with known lengths |
| `missing-refs` | An xref, a raster image and an SHX text style that cannot be found |
| `imperial` | Inches; ANSI D layout with a 1/8" = 1'-0" (1:96) viewport and a linear dimension |

- `*.dxf`: AC1032 (R2018) ASCII DXF, written by ezdxf. Byte-for-byte reproducible.
- `dwg/<name>.<version>.dwg`: DWG twins for R2000, R2004, R2007, R2010, R2013 and R2018, written
  by ODA File Converter. Its output changes on every run (timestamps), so only regenerate the
  twins when a DXF changes.
- `manifest.json`: what each fixture should convert to: page names and sizes in points,
  viewport ratios, positions and frozen layers, layers, dimension lengths, expected warnings,
  and text that must be searchable.

## Regenerate

```bash
pip install --user ezdxf==1.4.5
```

```bash
python scripts/make_cad_fixtures.py --check
```

With ODA File Converter installed (free from opendesign.com; dev-only, never shipped):

```bash
python scripts/make_cad_fixtures.py --dwg --check
```

`--check` reads every DXF back against the manifest. It also reads each DWG twin back through
the converter and checks it has the same entities per layout, the same layers and the same
layouts as its DXF. `--ref DIR` renders every layout to PDF with ezdxf's drawing add-on, as a
second opinion for visual comparison. Those PDFs are not committed.
